tool.name: RECAP-PROK CDS Interpretation
tool.description: CDS extension, truncation, locus-shift interpretation and summary figures

organization.name: Department Computational Biology and Chemistry (COMPBC), Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ)

tool.command:
set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p interpretation_out && printf 'path\tlabel\tsequence_type\n' > manifest.tsv &&
#for $dataset in $bacterial_pairs printf '%s\t%s\tbacteria\n' '$dataset' '$dataset.element_identifier' >> manifest.tsv && #end for
#for $dataset in $plasmid_pairs printf '%s\t%s\tplasmid\n' '$dataset' '$dataset.element_identifier' >> manifest.tsv && #end for
python '$__tool_directory__/pairs_classified_inter.py' --manifest manifest.tsv --output-table interpretation_out/CDS_mapping_summary_NCBI_reference_vs_Prodigal_reannotation.tsv --legend interpretation_out/module3_legend.txt --output-dir interpretation_out &&
test -s interpretation_out/CDS_mapping_summary_NCBI_reference_vs_Prodigal_reannotation.tsv && test -s interpretation_out/module3_legend.txt &&
cp interpretation_out/CDS_mapping_summary_NCBI_reference_vs_Prodigal_reannotation.tsv '$summary_table' && cp interpretation_out/module3_legend.txt '$legend' &&
#if $bacterial_pairs test -s interpretation_out/Figure_1A_bacterial_chromosomes_NCBI_vs_Prodigal_CDS_mapping.png && test -s interpretation_out/Figure_2A_bacterial_chromosomes_mean_CDS_length_change.png && cp interpretation_out/Figure_1A_bacterial_chromosomes_NCBI_vs_Prodigal_CDS_mapping.png '$fig_bac_mapping' && cp interpretation_out/Figure_2A_bacterial_chromosomes_mean_CDS_length_change.png '$fig_bac_length' && #end if
#if $plasmid_pairs test -s interpretation_out/Figure_1B_plasmids_NCBI_vs_Prodigal_CDS_mapping.png && test -s interpretation_out/Figure_2B_plasmids_mean_CDS_length_change.png && cp interpretation_out/Figure_1B_plasmids_NCBI_vs_Prodigal_CDS_mapping.png '$fig_pls_mapping' && cp interpretation_out/Figure_2B_plasmids_mean_CDS_length_change.png '$fig_pls_length' #end if

param.name: bacterial_pairs
param.label: Bacterial classified CDS-pair tables
param.help: One or more pairs_classified.tsv outputs from RECAP-PROK CDS comparison.

param.name: plasmid_pairs
param.label: Plasmid classified CDS-pair tables
param.help: One or more plasmid pairs_classified.tsv outputs from RECAP-PROK CDS comparison.

data.name: fig_bac_length
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: bacterial mean CDS length change

data.name: fig_pls_length
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: plasmid mean CDS length change

tool.help:
RECAP-PROK CDS Interpretation =============================
This tool summarizes classified CDS pairs generated by the RECAP-PROK CDS Comparison step.
The analysis includes:
- exact CDS matches - Prodigal CDS extensions relative to the mapped NCBI reference - Prodigal CDS truncations relative to the mapped NCBI reference - locus shifts - mean CDS length changes - bacterial and plasmid summary figures
The tool accepts multiple bacterial and plasmid input tables and does not depend on fixed genome identifiers or predefined file names.
Each input must be a ``pairs_classified.tsv`` output generated for the corresponding bacterial chromosome or plasmid.
The extension and truncation interpretation follows the RECAP-PROK CDS comparison logic.
